text: At its meeting held on July 17, 2025, the Toronto Police Service Board (Board): 1. receive the public report and Confidential Attachment 1 from the Auditor General. 2. direct that all information contained in Confidential Attachment1 to this report remain confidential. 3. forward this public report to City Council through the City's Audit Committee for information. Accordingly, we are forwarding a copy of the Board minute P2025-0717-2.0 and the pubic report from Auditor General to City Council through the City’s Audit Committee for information.
City Council on November 12 and 13, 2025, adopted the following: 1. City Council receive the report (June 26, 2025) from the Auditor General for information.
